executive_assessment.text: Ngambio/Itsali in Brazzaville's Tsième catchment and the Tchikobo–Songolo corridor in Pointe-Noire add named erosion/flood susceptibilities.
Unclear tenure requires careful consultation and due diligence. Bamboo demonstrations are preliminary capacity evidence, not citywide protection outcomes.

geographic_notes.text: Source dated 2025-12 reports: In Brazzaville's Tsieme catchment, runoff-fed active gullies at Ngambio and Itsali in Mfilou threaten nearby homes and infrastructure; at Ngambio, erosion continues despite existing channels.

Source dated 2025-12 reports: Exposed informal settlements, undersized drainage and catchment degradation amplify flood and erosion impacts; where land tenure is unclear, the report advises conflict-sensitive consultation and due diligence before works.

Source dated 2025-12 reports: November 2025 demonstrations observed sediment trapped by bamboo check-dams, considered locally replicable; site screening weighs security, institutions and social tensions.
Source dated 2025-12 reports: At Pointe-Noire's Tchikobo-Songolo corridor, project screening found high susceptibility to adjacent coastal floods and fluvial flooding intensified by rainfall runoff.
